hooks.name: pre-tool-security-gate
hooks.description: Blocks destructive shell or AWS deletion commands before execution.

action.command: python3 -c "import sys, json; ctx = json.load(sys.stdin); cmd = str(ctx.get(\"tool_input\", {}).get(\"command\", \"\")); blocked = [\"rm -rf /\", \"aws s3 rm\", \"terraform destroy\", \"DROP DATABASE\"]; hits = [b for b in blocked if b.lower() in cmd.lower()]; sys.stderr.write(f\"BLOCKED BY SECURITY GATE: {hits}\\n\") if hits else None; sys.exit(2 if hits else 0)"
